goal: Users receive accessible, prototype-aligned loading, empty, error, disabled, permission, and stale feedback across repository and pipeline route families without changing real data or permission contracts.
non_goals: Do not change routes, APIs, stores, pagination, authentication, permission calculation, persistence, or backend behavior.
Do not invent retry or success behavior.
Do not replace notifications, form validation, field-level disabled styling, or unrelated route content.
Do not add dependencies or prototype fixtures.
expected_evidence: Focused tests covering every FeedbackState variant, action slot, semantic role/live behavior, and compact rendering.
Focused tests proving Button and IconButton block click/navigation while loading or disabled and expose aria-busy.
Focused tests proving Error alert semantics and repository-branch plus pipeline-debug integration states.
Full Vitest, targeted Prettier, ESLint, TypeScript, Vite build, and git diff output.
Task report with A3 coverage and independent spec/quality reviews.
unsafe_assumptions: Visual opacity does not disable an interactive control.
Notifications do not replace persistent route feedback.
Permission and stale/conflict truth must remain sourced from existing production values.
A new generic state machine is not justified without a second real consumer.
stop_condition: Stop before editing outside the sixteen allowed files or adding retry, permission, API, store, persistence, or route behavior.
